# NOTES: *The Wings of the Morning* (Louis Tracy, 1903; Gutenberg #14917)

Epigraph: Psalm CXXXIX 9,10 ("If I take the wings of the morning...even there shall Thy hand lead me").

## CH I. The Wreck of the *Sirdar*
- Aboard *Sirdar* (London & Hong Kong Co. steamer, Sir Arthur Deane's fleet), homeward from Shanghai.
- **Lady Tozer**: gold-rimmed eyeglasses, "Mandarin" in Hong Kong. Asks re typhoon: "How horrible!"
- **Sir John Tozer**: ex-Chief Justice Hong Kong, bald, judicial frown. Gets water ice on head from steward.
- **Captain Ross**: commander; explains cyclone on menu card; "heavy bank of cloud...north-west."
- **Iris Deane**: under 21, blue eyes, shining brown hair; only daughter of **Sir Arthur Deane** (baronet, shipowner, Helmdale, Yorkshire). Back from Dresden 3 yrs ago. Maid: nose-tilted coquette.
- Lady Tozer: "Is it not true that you are going to marry Lord Ventnor?" Iris: "Lord Ventnor has not asked me."
- **Mr. Jones**: chief steward. Steward who spilled ice (later = Jenks) is fiercely staring; Iris noticed, Jones threatens to send him aft.
- Passengers: **Experience** (pompous "three days"), rosy subaltern, timid lady, **ship's surgeon** (flirts; "sea-king's daughter").
- Quartermaster **Jackson** (English) + 4 Lascars swept off forecastle; Jackson's wife & two children at Bombay-route meetings.
- Ship's bow: junk (Chinese, laden timber) collides; screw smashed, rudder wrenched. Sir John asks why not strike end-on; Captain: "You would never have known." Iris's clear voice: "murdered" line.
- Position ~14°N 112°E. Drift toward Borneo/South China Sea. Ship breaks on barrier reef; splits in two.

## CH II. The Survivors
- Jenks (sailor, ex-steward) grabs Iris (fainted) on binnacle pillar raft; both washed ashore on sand.
- Iris: "Why did you do that?" — he bit off his torn right forefinger nail.
- 14 bodies on beach: 3 women, 11 men (4 Lascars; incl surgeon, first officer, Sir John Tozer).
- Pitcher-plant water. Plantains. Iris asks "Is this a desert island?"; Jenks: "beche-de-mer" fishermen.
- Iris insists on "Miss Deane" not "madam." Name: "Jenks, madam. Robert Jenks."
- Iris binds finger with strip of her dress.

## CH III. Discoveries
- 2 Lascar bodies vanished from rocks.
- Jenks takes revolvers from doctor and first officer; money (Lascar jemadar, >£100 gold); inventories pocket-books.
- Bodies shot into lagoon; sharks.
- Salvage: 2 cases champagne, brandy, box of books, night glasses, compass, ship's biscuits, 2 cases hams, dish-covers, Lee-Metford ammunition (500 rounds/box), iron-cased rifle package.
- Lunch: ham & biscuits. Iris "Mrs. Crusoe" joke. Fire via binocular lens; sea-bird test shot at cocoanuts.
- Wou-wou monkey warble.
- Headless skeleton by well (blue serge, anchor buttons, rusted knife, tin canister lid with punched plan).
- Dyak suspicion (head-hunting).
- Iris shoots at "thing with waving arms" (octopus) at rocks.

## CH IV. Rainbow Island
- Cave: entrance 5 ft high, 30 ft deep, 10 ft wide, 7–8 ft high. Tools (2 pickaxes, shovel, sledge, axe, 3 crowbars), sextant, cartridge cases, 6 kerosene cases (1 half-full).
- Iris names island **Rainbow Island** ("Iris" = rainbow). Summit Rock. Quarry called "Limbo" (rejected).
- Iris: "Robert" in Greek = "menial."
- Jenks faints after washing; Iris gives champagne; "Permission to smoke"; Byron "Sublime tobacco."
- Tin plan: "J.S.", "32 divided by 1", X with dot.
- Horace: "Coelum non animum mutant."
- Iris cooks fried eggs; burnt ham.

## CH V. Iris to the Rescue
- Iris: navy dress, leather boots; sago from palm pith.
- Antimony vein; Jenks lies re Valley of Death.
- Valley of Death: quarry 100 ft diameter, 40 ft deep, carbonic acid gas; 9 Dyak bodies, Chinese coolie bodies, pigs.
- Jenks salvages rifles on Palm-tree Rock; octopus attacks him (5 arms). Iris fires 5 shots; third bullet → ink; axe. "We are quits now."

## CH VI. Some Explanations
- Seneca (Theresaea). Iris's ankle bruise; brandy.
- Rope-pulley ferry; raft with tea, flour, chair.
- Jenks: Indian Staff Corps 9 yrs; Soudan desert water; captaincy; **24th Lancers** (Lord Ventnor's regiment).
- Court-martial; cashiered; "Mrs. Costobell" (colonel's wife) accused him; he struck Ventnor.
- Iris: mother died of fever; father "only friend." Ages: Iris 20 (last December); Jenks 28 in August.
- Jenks: "Captain Anstruther" revealed; Iris: "I do not like her" (Mrs. Costobell); Ventnor "nothing to me."

## CH VII. Surprises
- "Belle Vue Castle" (tent-house, two rooms: Iris's niche; men's outer room).
- Singing beetle. Songs: "The Buffalo Battery."
- Fish tested by seabirds. Places named: North Cape, Europa Point, Filey Brig, North-west Reef, Prospect Park, Turtle Beach, Smugglers' Cove (south bay), Venus's Bath (Iris's bath basin).
- Stranded boat at Europa Point: tins, biscuits, 2 water casks.
- Cheval de frise (bayonets) before cave.
- Day 19: Iris cries "Robert!" → 9 Dyaks (Jenks with Lee-Metford kills them, sampan escapes). Dyak leader + men; Iris pleads "This is murder!"

## CH VIII. Preparations
- Dyak chief loses 2–3 fingers right hand (Taung S'Ali, named later).
- Storm; spring-gun sentries at Smugglers' Cove.
- Eagle's Nest (ledge 40 ft up over cave; later reached by pole/ladder).
- Iris: "Ah, evidently I snore." ("I can always tell whether you are in the next room.")
- Rope-ladder: 60 rungs.
- Monkeys trigger watch-guns; Jenks carries Iris up ledge.

## CH IX. The Secret of the Cave
- Scarecrows; belt of flaxen human hair.
- Gold discovered: "32 divided by 1" = 32 ft in, 1 ft down. Chinese killed by CO2.
- Jenks writes letter (leaves 2 pages, "DEAR MISS DEANE...I love you"; one-sixth to uncle William Anstruther of Crossthwaite Manor, Northallerton); tears it up.
- Iris finds scraps ("Miss Deane," "I love you"); keeps in gold locket (miniatures of parents).
- Tennyson *Maud*/*Enoch Arden*; "Sonata Pathétique."
- Pleiades; Dyak superstition.

## CH X. Reality v. Romance—The Case for the Plaintiff
- 44 notches on sun-dial → 1 May (Sirdar lost 18 March).
- Lessons: algebra; Hindustani; "Kiplingese."
- Iris's trousers (turned-up).
- Smoke of far steamer → false alarm.
- Iris learns Lee-Metford at 80 yds.
- Jenks's story: Elizabeth Morris ("Bessie"), Commissioner's niece, Simla; Lord Ventnor; United Service Club row; horse "Sultan" (Pagoda Hurdle).
- Colonel Costobell; Mrs. Costobell flirts with Ventnor; club grounds Hong Kong; "I nearly killed him."
- Iris prays for his name. Jenks "I am here!"
- Dyaks land at night; "Up the ladder!"

## CH XI. The Fight
- Spring-guns; Dyak chief sees boat/skeleton ("the pieces of furniture").
- Jenks sets skeleton with matches (sulphur fumes); Dyaks scared.
- 61 Dyaks counted; sampans; Mahommedan in turban (later Mir Jan).
- Iris sleeps; Jenks watches. Dyak sees ledge; birds reveal.
- Jenks shoots 4+ Dyaks ("first shot of real warfare").
- Iris reads Psalm 91. Cut forehead.

## CH XII. A Truce
- Water casks burst; one pint left.
- Sampan sunk; Jenks lies to Iris about sinking.
- Mahommedan interpreter: "Me English speak it."
- Taung S'Ali (Dyak chief) demands the woman. Jenks: "Anstruther Sahib, of the Belgaum Rissala."
- Indian (ex-**Kumaon Rissala**) promises help; Dyaks disguise.
- Dyak swap: Taung S'Ali escapes disguised.
- Blowpipes/sumpitans foreshadowed.

## CH XIII. Reality v. Romance—The Case for the Defendant
- Iris offers to surrender to Dyaks. Jenks: "Iris!" → declares love; "Robert dear"; "Let us die together."
- Iris has his love notes.
- Poison arrows (upas juice) confirmed by champagne test.
- Jenks kills blowpipe men.
- Night: Jenks goes down for water; Iris: "Robert, where are you?"
- Mine trap: loaded rifle + 300 cartridges + powder in tree near Valley of Death; blast killed Dyaks on ledge.

## CH XIV. The Unexpected Happens
- Mir Jan (ex-naik, Kumaon Rissala, B troop; Colonel "Kurnal I-shpence-sahib"); Taung S'Ali's men building 4 scaling ladders; sky-sign pulled down.
- Water via goatskin (Mir Jan).
- Iris fires down rock; Jenks throws revolver; crowbar fight.
- Dyak smoke (seaweed mistaken for green wood); tarpaulin barrier on pickaxe.
- 12-pounder shrapnel from warship. "My darling, we are saved!"

## CH XV. The Difficulty of Pleasing Everybody
- HMS *Orient* (cruiser); Lieutenant **Philip H. Playdon**; Captain Fitzroy; Sir Arthur aboard; Lord Ventnor aboard.
- Taung S'Ali killed by Mir Jan.
- Robert claims island in King's name.
- Sir Arthur: "Robert Jenks!"; Iris: "my affianced husband stands here."
- Robert confesses court-martial to officers.
- Playdon's £50 loan (from Playdon, Fitzroy, first lieutenant).

## CH XVI. Bargains, Great and Small
- Ventnor plots: Costobells in Singapore; "licked me twice."
- Fitzroy vs. Ventnor exchange (Singapore rumour).
- Mir Jan's turban at Robert's feet; "I am your dog."
- Sir Arthur's losses: *Sirdar*, *Bahadur* (sunk Mersey 25 March), *Jemadar* (James & Mary shoal, Hooghly); ~£600,000 loss.
- Ventnor's bargain: Iris for loan; Sir Arthur coerced.
- Dyaks sent home.

## CH XVII. Rainbow Island Again—And Afterward
- Robert tells Sir Arthur of Ventnor's guilt.
- Sir Arthur: £10,000 needed; Robert offers money; uncle **William Anstruther** cables.
- Singapore: Mrs. Costobell died of enteric; confesses; Costobell clears Robert; Ventnor's name disgraced.
- Marriage: English Church, Hong Kong (on gazetted reinstatement day).
- Playdon best man. Robert resigns commission.
- Mining begins; Mir Jan pardoned; light on Summit Rock.
- Iris: "So happy and thankful."

## POSTSCRIPT
- Letter from **Matilda** to Helen (~4 yrs later): Anstruthers at Fairlawn estate; children Robert Jenks Anstruther; Mrs. Anstruther ("Lord Ventnor need not have been so frightened...my husband has not brought his hunting-crop").
- NOTE: Colonel Anstruther's agents trace **James Spence** (Shields marine engineer) as the recluse of Rainbow Island; circumstantial; family provided for.
